sources.title: Horinger New Area news item: 'From WAIC to Inner Mongolia Horinger New Area: three looks at the compute acceleration in the free trade zone' (从WAIC到内蒙古和林格尔新区：“三看”自贸试验区里的算力“加速度”), 10 August 2026

sources.attribution: 内蒙古和林格尔新区党群服务中心, via the Horinger New Area Management Committee website (hlgena.huhhot.gov.cn)
sources.summary: Work-news item dated 10 August 2026 (发布时间), source line 内蒙古和林格尔新区党群服务中心, on the New Area management committee's website. Under 'hard base' it describes the area's compute providers. It says the BONC (东方国信) Horinger intelligent computing centre (东方国信和林格尔智算中心) has a total investment of CNY 4.8 billion and is planned to exceed 100,000 P of intelligent compute. Its self-developed 幕僚智数 model training and inference platform is adapted to Ascend chips. At present the base's customers cover research institutions and AI service providers, and orders for domestic customised compute are growing steadily (当前基地客户覆盖科研机构、AI服务商，国产化定制算力订单稳步增长). The same item describes the China Mobile Hohhot liquid-cooled intelligent computing centre and the Paratera (并行科技) Inner Mongolia base. It reports that Kuaishou signed a compute project with the Hohhot government in January 2026. It also says Phase 1 of Volcano Engine's 火山云谷基地 has entered substantive construction (about 12 ha, four data-centre buildings and a 110 kV substation energised in November 2025).
sources.date_semantics: Published 10 August 2026. Present-tense government statement that the BONC Horinger base currently serves customers. It is read as the observation that the base operates as of publication. No opening day, phase or building is named, and the planned 100,000 P is a target.

sources.title: Environmental impact report form: BONC Industrial Internet Northern Regional Center Phase 2 2# 110 kV substation (东方国信工业互联网北方区域中心项目二期工程2#110kV变电站工程), published with the Hohhot EEB acceptance notice of 26 August 2025
sources.attribution: 呼和浩特市生态环境局 (Hohhot Ecology and Environment Bureau)
sources.summary: EIA report form (128 pages, compiled August 2025; project code 2406-150123-89-04-770345). It is built by Inner Mongolia BONC Technology Co., Ltd. (内蒙古东方国信科技有限公司) in the Yungu area of Horinger New Area, Horinger County, Hohhot. The station centre is printed as 40°32'31.242" N, 111°48'38.413" E. The four footprint corners are given in CGCS2000 grid coordinates (table 2-4). The report says the BONC Industrial Internet Northern Regional Center plans about 198 mu of land with 8 data machine-room buildings, a production operations centre, a living-services centre and a 110 kV substation. It lays out about 20,000 8 kW standard and 10.8-24 kW intelligent-computing cabinets. Phase 1 has been in operation since 2025 (一期工程已于2025年投运). Phase 2 was filed with the New Area on 13 June 2024 and is under construction. The 2# substation lies in the central-east of the plant area and was not yet built. Appendices include the Phase 2 filing notice (six data-centre machine-room buildings, CNY 3 billion, 2024/08-2027/10), the real-estate certificate for the industrial land, the 2023 EIA registration form for the whole project (130,939.21 m2 site in the Shengle modern service cluster), the campus site plan and site photographs. The contact names and telephone numbers printed in the report and its appendices are not reproduced. Appendix 5 is the 2019 Horinger County real-estate certificate (real-estate unit 150123400505GB00066W00000000): state-owned construction-land use right held solely by Inner Mongolia BONC Technology Co., Ltd. for industrial land of 130,939.21 m2 in the Hohhot Shengle modern service cluster, 8 May 2019 to 7 May 2069.
sources.date_semantics: Report compiled August 2025 and published with the acceptance notice of 26 August 2025. Locator and identity source only. Its Phase 1 operation and Phase 2 construction statements are older than the admission window and are not the status observation.
sources.coordinate_crs: Printed geographic degrees-minutes-seconds, consistent within 1.44 m with the report's own CGCS2000 3-degree Gauss-Kruger (CM 111E, EPSG:4546) corner coordinates of the substation footprint. Transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees with no datum transformation.

Its introduction states that the licence is for the operation of an installation 'which will include 1 no. energy centre, 2 no. data centres and associated infrastructure': energy centre ESSDUB97 with 20 gas engines of 10.3 MWth (up to 18 running continuously on natural gas, only on EirGrid instruction) and data centres EDCDUB04 and EDCDUB05 with 48 back-up generators on gas oil, supplied from the national grid in normal operation.
sources.date_semantics: Given under seal and posted to LEAP on 3 September 2026 (publication date); newspaper notice 9 September 2026. The licence names and describes the planned installation in the future tense. It supports an announced project as of 3 September 2026; it is not planning consent and states no construction, completion or operation.

sources.title: EPA Inspector's Report on IE licence application P1204-01, Edgeconnex Ireland Limited, Newcastle Road, Lucan (17 December 2025)
sources.attribution: Environmental Protection Agency (Ireland), LEAP
sources.summary: The inspector describes a c. 22.1 ha installation site of partly greenfield and brownfield land west of the R120, bounded by the Grand Canal to the north, with the applicant's existing data-centre campus (DUB01, DUB02 and DUB03, not IE-licensed) east of the R120. EDCDUB04 and EDCDUB05 will each have two single-storey data halls and 24 back-up generators of 6.9 MWth; 'When constructed', their generator yards will hold the generators, and 'Upon completion of construction' the installation will operate around the clock. Table 3.1 lists the permissions: SD19A/0042 and ABP-305948-19 (granted 5 October 2020) and SD23A/0151 (2 October 2023) for EDCDUB04 and the GIS substation ESSDUB98 (operational, EirGrid-owned); SD21A/0042 and ABP-312749-22 (appeal withdrawn; granted March 2022) and SD22A/0289 (10 February 2023) for EDCDUB05 and ESSDUB97; ABP-314567-22 (28 November 2023) for substation transmission connections. EDCDUB06 (SD22A/0333, ABP-317802-23) is excluded from the licence.
